6afc7528-852f-4875-a086-0943b85e41ea/Eve.en: "We are bound by fate, so I will help you..."<NL><NL><Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> reaches out, takes the Nirvana Pill, and swallows it.<NL>Instantly, a gentle breeze emanates from their body, making their form more ethereal.<NL>Points of light appear at their forehead, chest, and abdomen,<NL>then streams of light extend, connecting with one another and forming their shape...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> has become one of the Thoughtless...)</color>
